bio: Welcome to Harvard! My name is Ebun, and I am from the suburbs of Atlanta, Georgia. I graduated from Princeton University in 2024, where I studied Public & International Affairs. While there, I served as a Residential College Adviser and was involved in the African Students Association. I also did fun research on international trade and electric vehicles. I came directly to Harvard, where I am now a 2nd year law student. In my free time, I enjoy running, reading, and cooking. I look forward to meeting you!
